result.description: Twilio SendGrid: cloud email delivery platform for transactional and marketing email (send API, templates, contacts, campaigns, stats).
result.auth_detail: Per-account API keys with scoped permissions, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'. Each user creates their own key in the Console. No public OAuth2 flow for third-party developers was found in the docs.
result.access_detail: Gate 1 (review/partner): none. Each end user creates their own API key in their own account, so no app review or listing is needed. Gate 2 (paid): the pricing page offers only a no-card free trial, and I found no permanent free tier. Continued API use needs a paid plan after the trial. I did not confirm the trial length or the free-tier retirement on a vendor page.
result.api_notes: v3 Web API (REST) covers mail send, marketing contacts, lists, segments, single sends, templates, suppressions, stats, webhooks, subusers, domain/sender authentication, API keys, and more. SMTP relay is also available.
result.blocker: No permanent free tier: only a free trial, then a paid plan. End users must paste their own API key (no OAuth). No vendor-official MCP server found.

evidence.quote: The Twilio SendGrid Console displays the API key only once at creation.
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required.
